fields.statement: Risk warnings change set (01M6W4K4) serves no intent yet. Which should it serve? Its sibling Workflow dispatch (also from PR #353) serves milestone-25 (backlog: requests and polish ship on their own); milestone-29 (several projects under one root) is the other open one. / Rhiza has no schedule trigger of its own (a cron job would just run `rhiza request`), and autonomy is repo-wide (git config rhiza.autonomy.plan/ship), not per workflow. Which workflows should rhiza health and rhiza workflow check flag as 'outside text reaches agents with no permission checks'? / Where does the risk warning appear in rhiza health's report? / Workflow dispatch (01M6VY7G, accepted, not built) adds .rhiza/dispatch.toml rules that change which workflow a request or ready change set runs. Should Risk warnings wait for it?
